narrative:
Revenue is planned as shipments × revenue per shipment by business line, agency region, customer segment and lane, plus the fuel surcharge indexed to the CNR diesel index. The Q3 Forecast lands FY2026 at €286.8M, €6.0M below budget: Road Groupage −€4.1M and Full Truckload −€1.0M; Customs and Air & Sea are close to plan.

Groupage revenue per shipment is €99.0 YTD (+3.6% on 2025) with the GRI and a higher fuel surcharge. Volume is the gap: Sud is down after Marseille-Vitrolles lost a retail key account, and industrial FTL in Est and Germany is soft.

The ML volume forecast (agency series with working days and the diesel index) proposes the Q4 baseline: +2.1% groupage in Île-de-France and Rhône-Alpes for the retail peak and +4% air volume at Roissy in December.

signals.title: Q3 forecast €286.8M — about €6M below the FY2026 budget
signals.source: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget
signals.excerpt: Full truckload and road groupage volumes are softer than budgeted. Air & sea and customs are close to plan. EBITDA lands at €17.1M, about 0.25 points of margin below budget.

signals.title: Three agencies behind plan on margin per shipment
signals.source: SDP agency margin monitor — FY2026 YTD (synthetic data)
signals.excerpt: Marseille-Vitrolles, Rouen and Mulhouse are together about €0.6M behind budget YTD (€0.8M for the full year): a lost key account, a higher subcontracting share after driver shortages, and cross-border surcharge lag.

signals.title: Hyperion finance data on Snowflake since September 2024
signals.excerpt: The Oracle/Hyperion finance database was migrated to Snowflake in 2024; budgeting and forecasting still run in Hyperion and Excel. SDP plans on the same governed data.
